platform: actual OpenHarmony LiteOS-M kernel on QEMU mps2-an386, instruction-counted virtual time

scheduler.objective: mean_turn + 0.5*p95_response, guest timer cycles; lower is better

context_features: a separate pilot run on default parameters; no held-out test measurements used to select parameters
notes: Protocol fixed before main data collection. Unseen test contexts include both input interpolation and memory mode3 shift. QEMU cannot establish physical hardware latency, power or thermal gains. Simulator measurements in the old deliverable remain separate.
